basics.summary: Prototyper. Builder. Full-stack developer. Python enthusiast. AI practioner. I love software craftmanship, tinkering with technology, and designing solutions to real-world problems. I prioritize product usability through user feedback and documentation, and I focus on simplicity and maintainability. I have a growth mindset and seek to learn new things. Everyday. I choose practicality over purity. I enjoy good team work, genuine collaborations, and trustworthy open-source communities.

work.summary: Designing and implementing secure cloud and on-premises solutions to monitor distributed systems. Driving continuous improvements using open standards and best-practices. Escalating, root cause analyzing and resolving software defects and performance issues. Peer-reviewing code to maintain quality and sharing knowledge across teams. Writing user needs, requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, and technical documentation. Leading software verification activities during product releases to ensure quality and compliance with technical requirements. Supporting field engineers with software installations, patching, and upgrades. Investigating field issues, assistance requests (ARs), customer complaints, non-compliance (NC), and participating in post-mortem analysis.

work.summary: Designing and implementing code and algorithms for radiotherapy treatment management and planning applications. Resolving defects in advanced algorithms for medical image analysis. Testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) to ensure software quality. Peer-reviewing code and sharing knowledge across teams. Following design and development processes to ensure accuracy, safety, and compliance with medical software regulations. Collaborating with DevOps engineers to optimize automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual effort and improving release confidence

work.summary: Designing, developing, testing, documentating, and packaging software. Creating an innovative pulse shaping framework (shapr) to overcome major challenges in the domain of ultrafast spectroscopy. Designing novel data acquisition techniques and data processing algorithms. Managing laboratory equipments and assets (lasers, spectrometers, spatial-light modulators). Maintaining and optimizating high-power femto-second lasers (oscillator, amplificator, strecher, compressor). Investigating light-matter interaction to understand and control the dynamics of energy conversion and transfer in macro-molecules.
